id: title:Gilbert09:sync the ad creatives table past a creative meta refuses to serve

review.reason: Adds a second Meta API refusal subcode and updates the warehouse ingestion recovery path to recognize both, preventing warehouse sync stalling. P1.F1.H2 adds the new subcode to the refusal set; P1.F1.H3 updates the recovery check; P1.F1.H4 adds a type safety check and complete set validation. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement for warehouse data,
review.uncertainty: The actual production impact depends on the frequency of this specific Meta API error, which is not established by the code alone. The benefit is demonstrated by the implementation of recovery, not by observed adoption or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Adds a second Meta error subcode (1443048) alongside the existing one, and updates the set of refused subcodes.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Meta Ads warehouse ingestion to recognize and handle a previously unhandled Meta API refusal error, preventing the entire warehouse sync from stalling when this specific error occurs.

observations.behavior: Updates the helper function and its usage to check against the new set of refused subcodes rather than a single constant.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the error detection and recovery path to account for both recognized refusal subcodes, ensuring the warehouse ingestion can recover from either error type.

observations.behavior: Updates the node lookup refusal check to use the set of refused subcodes and adds a type check for the subcode.
observations.code_quote: if not isinstance(subcode, int) or subcode not in META_REFUSED_CREATIVE_ERROR_SUBCODES:
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a safeguard against non-integer subcodes and checks against the complete set of refused subcodes, improving the robustness of the warehouse ingestion recovery path.
